Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix image preview using React state instead of DOM manipulation

When editing a product with a broken image URL, the previous approach
hid the img element via DOM which prevented new image previews from
showing. Now uses imageError state that resets when a new file is
selected, so the preview works correctly.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(gh pr create --title "Fix image preview and add error display" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary
- Fix broken image preview in ProductForm when editing products with unavailable images \(uses React state instead of DOM manipulation\)
- Add error display to public Products page for debugging Supabase RLS issues

## Test plan
- [ ] Edit a product with a broken image URL - should show "Imagen anterior no disponible" message
- [ ] Select a new image file - preview should appear correctly
- [ ] Check public Products page shows products \(requires anon SELECT RLS policy in Supabase\)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)" --base main --head claude/vibrant-poitras)
